description: Acceptance criteria (Gherkin) writer — Turn a user story into testable Given/When/Then scenarios (happy, edge, error, security) plus non-functional criteria, out-of-scope items and open questions. Offline lint: missing Given/When/Then, untestable wording (fast, intuitive, appropriate...), invented numbers not in the story, scenario coverage, story format check; testability score and READY/REVIEW/NEEDS_WORK. Optional: context. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

story.description: e.g. As a shopper I want to reset my password by email so that I can regain access. The reset link expires after 30 minutes.

name: ai_acceptance_criteria
